queue_sha_lint: 2 citation(s) DECLARED unresolvable here:
    c8b65ba  UNPUSHED — the PRE-REBASE D3 flag-pair commit, on the local-only branch `flag-pair-moe-cache`; never pushed, so CI cannot resolve it (it failed there 2026-08-12). DELIBERATELY NOT re-pointed to its rebased successor `bacc04c` (on main via the D3 merge): the two have DIFFERENT patch-ids, and the passage citing this one is historical — it describes the branch as it stood BEFORE the rebase ("its branch predates the fix it completes"), which `bacc04c` no longer illustrates. Re-pointing would keep the lint green by making the surrounding sentence false. Allowlisted rather than laundered. Flagged 2026-08-12
    d682315  UNPUSHED — Metal branch `metal-rope-merge`, mac-local; not on origin and not in any clone here. Owner: whoever cited it. P4's "already implemented, snapshot-golden byte-exact" rests on a commit only that machine can see; push the branch or the claim stays unverifiable from anywhere else. Flagged 2026-08-12
queue_citation_lint: SKIPPED 2 citation(s) — the repo they resolved in is not checked out here:
    ada417e  (recorded in: aikit)
    be049df  (recorded in: aikit)
queue_citation_lint: 876 symbol citation(s) (path.go:Name) across 145 live document(s), each checked against the declarations the file has now; 41 PINNED record(s) checked at their commits (citations-at), never against HEAD and never rewritten.
queue_citation_lint: EXAMINED 867 live markdown document(s) of 1030 in the tree (140 excluded as docs/completed/ by the archival rule below; 0 excluded as docs/internal/, which is gitignored and so resolves on this machine only). A document that leaves this denominator leaves the lint silently.
queue_citation_lint: VALIDATED 43 commit citation(s) in docs/QUEUE.md, 1 path:line citation(s) across 1 live document(s), and 29 bare file reference(s) in the queue (existence only).
  CROSS-REPO RESOLUTION: 23 path lookup(s) answered from the MODULE CACHE at the version go.mod requires, 816 from a checkout.
    github.com/townsendmerino/aikit -> module cache @ v1.76.0
  docs/completed/ is EXCLUDED on purpose — archived records are supposed to age with the code they described, and linting them would fight the archival rule.
  NOT validated: RELEVANCE. A commit citation is checked to resolve and to match its recorded subject; nothing checks that the commit SUPPORTS the claim made about it.
    9e5f8fa passed green through two documents for weeks as "the goldens-refresh precedent" while touching the manifest not at all — a resolving sha with a matching subject and a false claim attached.
    The same gap on the PATH side, and worse because the anchor keeps working: docs/task-moe-streaming.md read "goinfer is now on aikit v1.16.0 (go.mod:6)". The aikit bump changed what go.mod:6 SAYS without changing that it is the aikit require, so the content key still matched and the citation stayed green while the version it asserted went stale. A path citation is checked to point somewhere stable — not to still mean what the sentence around it claims.
  Also NOT validated: every test name, tag, env var and URL — and for the bare file references, WHAT IS SAID ABOUT THEM, since there is no line to key against.
  A lint on a document raises trust in EVERY citation in it, not only the kinds it checks — so the scope is printed with the green.
  GITIGNORED DESTINATIONS: none. A committed document citing a path under a gitignored directory is red without an existence test — the gitignore status decides, because an uncommitted target has no history to audit.
